name: @dusk/core
comment:exports: `.` is browser-safe and is what @dusk/arkiv, the worker loop and three pages import. `./env` and `./credentials-file` read config.json off the disk through node:fs, so they are subpaths rather than index exports — the same split @dusk/worker makes for ./loop. A Node entry point imports './env' right after 'dotenv/config'; nothing else may import either.
